await (async (page) => {const results=[];for(const width of [1440,390,768]){await page.setViewportSize({width,height:width===1440?900:width===390?844:1024});for(const name of ['launch','network','clients']){if(width<=850){await page.locator('#console-sidebar-toggle').click();await page.waitForTimeout(200);}await page.locator('[data-tab="'+name+'"]').click();await page.waitForTimeout(260);await page.screenshot({path:'D:/Serveur IA/audits/2026-10-22-ux/corrections/console-'+name+'-'+width+'.png'});results.push(await page.evaluate(name=>({name,width:innerWidth,scroll:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,focus:document.activeElement.id,title:document.querySelector('h1').textContent}),name));}}await page.locator('#console-sidebar-toggle').click();await page.waitForTimeout(200);await page.locator('#tab-launch').focus();const ids=[];for(let i=0;i<18;i++){ids.push(await page.evaluate(()=>document.activeElement.id));await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');}if(ids.some(id=>!id.startsWith('tab-')))throw Error('Console arrow navigation lost focus');await page.keyboard.press('Escape');await page.screenshot({path:'D:/Serveur IA/audits/2026-10-22-ux/corrections/console-keyboard.png'});return {results,arrowSequence:ids};})(page);

### Ran Playwright code
```js
await (async (page) => {const results=[];for(const theme of ['light','dark']){await page.evaluate(theme=>uiSetTheme(theme),theme);const samples=await page.evaluate(()=>{const s=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);return Object.fromEntries(['text','sidebar','raised','background'].map((k,i)=>[k,s.getPropertyValue(['--muted','--sidebar','--raised','--bg'][i]).trim()]));});const lum=value=>{const hex=value.length===4?'#'+value.slice(1).split('').map(c=>c+c).join(''):value;return hex.slice(1).match(/../g).map(c=>parseInt(c,16)/255).map(c=>c<=.04045?c/12.92:((c+.055)/1.055)**2.4).reduce((s,v,i)=>s+v*[.2126,.7152,.0722][i],0);};results.push({theme,samples,ratios:Object.fromEntries(['sidebar','raised','background'].map(k=>[k,(Math.max(lum(samples.text),lum(samples[k]))+.05)/(Math.min(lum(samples.text),lum(samples[k]))+.05)]))});}return results;})(page);
```
